name: Ask And You Shall Receive
overview: Scripture reveals that God invites His people to approach Him with confident prayer, promising that those who ask will receive, seek will find, and knock will have doors opened to them, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 7:7. This assurance is grounded in faith, as believers are called to pray with the conviction that they have already received what they desire (Matthew 21:22; Mark 11:24). Furthermore, God’s goodness as a loving Father is highlighted in Luke 11:13, where He is portrayed as eager to give the Holy Spirit to those who ask. The call to persistent prayer, without losing heart, emphasizes reliance on God’s timing and provision (Luke 18:1), while Psalm 37:4 encourages delighting in the Lord so that He may grant the desires aligned with His will.
